plugins.name: product
plugins.description: A money-gated lifecycle for taking consumer one-off / in-app-purchase products from idea to validated bet through launch and live-ops. Provides 10 stage playbooks (discovery, ideation, monetization design, validation, vertical-slice/MVP, production hardening, compliance, soft-launch, GTM launch, live-ops, and portfolio retrospective) plus a shared money-gate and unit-economics discipline, orchestrated by a coordinator and specialist, reviewer, and synthesizer agents that fan out, adversarially review, and synthesize each stage against net-of-fee economics.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Gaia's spec-driven software delivery lifecycle: intake, architecture, planning, implementation, testing, and release. Provides stage playbooks (architecture documentation, default tech stack, execution planning, engineering delivery, UI engineering, formal testing, and end-to-end process orchestration) plus the specialist agents (intake coordinator, solutions architect, implementation planner, software engineer, tester, release engineer) that take a goal from request to validated, released software through enforced QA and release gates.
